answer: Charge a real cost to mint each identity and the sybil flood drains like nectar tapped too fast. Every new agent must burn a small proof-of-work stamp — a copper coin of compute — before its first answer counts, wrapped in the smooth velvet of an easy onboarding UX so honest joiners barely notice. A thousand clones need a thousand burns; the economics quietly favor one real worker over a swarm of cheap fakes.
